summary: Dedicated Childcare Worker with over 10 years of experience fostering safe, nurturing environments for children in center-based settings. Skilled in monitoring play activities, supporting social-emotional growth, and maintaining open communication with guardians.

experience.title: Lead Childcare Worker
experience.employer: a growing mid-market early learning center
bullets: Maintain a safe play environment for up to 18 children, conducting daily safety checks and immediately addressing hazards.
Observe and monitor children's play activities, documenting developmental milestones and behavioral observations in daily records.
Communicate with guardians about daily activities, behaviors, and any related issues through written reports and in-person updates.
Support children's emotional and social development by modeling positive interactions and encouraging understanding of others.
Sanitize toys and play equipment throughout the day, reducing illness transmission and maintaining health standards.
Assist with dressing, diapering, and toileting routines for children ages 2-4, ensuring dignity and hygiene.
Keep detailed records on individual children, including daily observations, meals served, and medications administered.

experience.title: Childcare Worker
bullets: Cared for children in a nursery school setting, supervising indoor and outdoor play to ensure physical safety.
Implemented daily activity schedules that promoted active listening, sharing, and cooperative play among peers.
Communicated with guardians regarding daily activities and behavioral observations, maintaining confidentiality and professionalism.
Sanitized toys and play areas multiple times daily, adhering to state licensing and health guidelines.
Changed diapers and assisted with dressing for toddlers, following individualized care plans.
Recorded daily observations and meal consumption for each child, providing written summaries to guardians.

experience.title: Assistant Childcare Provider
experience.employer: a growing mid-market corporate childcare facility
bullets: Maintained a safe play environment for infants and toddlers, monitoring for potential hazards during all activities.
Observed and monitored children's play activities to identify developmental needs and report concerns to lead staff.
Supported children's emotional and social development through positive reinforcement and one-on-one interaction.
Sanitized toys and equipment after each use, reducing cross-contamination and maintaining cleanliness standards.
Assisted with diaper changes and dressing, ensuring comfort and adherence to hygiene protocols.
Kept records on individual children, including daily activities, meals served, and any medications administered.

experience.title: Childcare Aide
experience.employer: a mid-market group home for children with disabilities
bullets: Cared for children in an institutional group home setting, providing supervision and emotional support.
Maintained a safe play environment by conducting regular safety inspections and removing hazards.
Observed and monitored play activities to ensure inclusion and safety for children with diverse needs.
Communicated with guardians about daily activities and behaviors during pick-up and through daily logs.
Sanitized toys and adaptive equipment, following infection control protocols.
Assisted with dressing and diapering as needed, respecting individual care plans and dignity.

education.degree: Associate of Applied Science in Early Childhood Education
